changes: Prioritize service depot and tank production budget over repeated infantry and extra barracks
Cap supporting infantry while preserving early emergency defense, a minimum rocket contingent, power and harvester recovery
Prefer a second factory over additional barracks when the economy supports it
Require three healthy tanks in the actual attacking wave; do not allocate all tanks to home reserve
Discount anti-infantry units against visible armor in conservative strength checks
Do not disable unfavorable-engagement checks at the end of a losing game
Retain map adaptation, safe expansion, anti-fortification checks and conditional siege support

comparison_method.payment: Progressive production cost with short category queues
comparison_method.map_income_and_factory_speed: Simplified synthetic assumptions, not calibrated live-map estimates

limitations: Production-direction evidence only; no claim of increased real match win rate
Type weights, cash thresholds and three-tank requirement are heuristic
No fresh real-engine map/faction/duration sweep for this revision
Existing matches retain their already-loaded version; new workers load this revision
